text:
Maya (CS): Quick batch from this week's onboarding + renewal check-ins — dropping asks for product triage. TL;DR: three customer asks that are either blocking go-live or flagged as renewal risk.

Maya (CS): 1) Brightline Health — needs environment-scoped API keys (dev/stage/prod) and per-environment audit logs for compliance. Contract clause: keys must be isolated by environment. Legal deadline EOW for their pilot.

Maya (CS): 2) NovaRetail — asks for per-route usage caps and an on/off toggle per route. They hit a surprise bill in pilot and want control to avoid overage during peak promotions (pilot ARR ~$80k, renewal likely depends on this).

Maya (CS): 3) SummitHealth — wants an in-console onboarding checklist + sample prompts/templates and a guided walkthrough so their Ops team adopts embeddings-based search faster. Adoption stalled ~30%.

Maya (CS): I put customer notes + call snippets in this doc: https://redwood.internal/cs/asks/1749876543 (spreadsheet w/ severity & revenue impact).

Lina (PM): Thanks Maya — can you add: expected impact (estimate % adoption or $ at risk) and an acceptance criteria line for each ask? That helps me slice into MVP vs follow-up.

Maya (CS): Added quick numbers in sheet (col D/E). Brightline = legal block (high), NovaRetail = $80k at risk (high), Summit = adoption drop (med). Acceptance criteria examples included.

Alex (SRE): Heads up — per-route caps are non-trivial in the runtime right now. We can do an edge proxy-enforced quota as a short-term mitigation (fast) and a native runtime counter in a later sprint (longer).

Alex (SRE): Short mitigation sketch:
```
proxy.rules:
  - route: /api/v1/generate/invoice
    quota_per_minute: 1000
    hard_toggle: true
```

Sam (Product): For NovaRetail I think we can ship a feature-flagged route toggle + UI in 2 sprints if PM + SRE agree on scope. Propose: "route toggle (UI)" as MVP, "native runtime quota" as follow-up.

Diego (AE): Brightline legal is strict — they gave a hard date. If we can't provide env-scoped keys by then they will postpone pilot and we risk the contract. Can we prioritize that?

Lina (PM): Agreed. Re-prioritizing: Brightline key scoping = P0 (legal). NovaRetail route toggle = P0/P1 depending on mitigation. Summit onboarding templates = P2 but quick wins possible (docs + templates).

triage-bot: Created ticket RDW-4321 (env-key-scoping) and RDW-4322 (route-toggle-proxy-mitigation). Links: https://redwood.jira/RDW-4321, https://redwood.jira/RDW-4322

Maya (CS): Assigning owners: Lina -> RDW-4321 (env keys) owner, Alex -> RDW-4322 (route toggle mitigation) owner, Sam -> onboarding templates (I'll coordinate Summit playbook).

Lina (PM): I'll draft acceptance criteria for RDW-4321 tonight. Main asks: distinguish keys by env, KMS integration for rotation, audit-log export per-env, and an API to list keys by environment. If any of that is hard, call it out.

Alex (SRE): Noted. KMS rotation + per-env audit logs will touch infra. I'll scope POC for proxy mitigation by EOD Fri, and put runtime design story for next planning.

Diego (AE): I'll message Brightline legal and try to buy a week if needed; also flag renewal rep.

Maya (CS): Thanks all. Can we confirm on this thread when RDW-4321 has a tentative ETA? Brightline needs a date to avoid pausing pilot.

Sam (Product): :eyes: I'll tag engineering in RDW-4321 and schedule a 30m sync for tomorrow.

Maya (CS): +1. Also, adding a quick ask — if we ship proxy toggle, put a clear UI note: "temporary mitigation - not billing-accurate". NovaRetail told me they need the toggle ASAP even if imperfect.

Lina (PM): Will do. Thanks Maya — I'll update the sheet and move RDW-4321 to "in progress" once the design sync finishes.

Maya (CS): Awesome. Follow-ups:
- Maya -> sync with Brightline legal Thu 10:00am
- Alex -> POC proxy rules by Fri EOD
- Lina -> acceptance criteria + design sync tomorrow
- Sam -> onboarding templates draft by next Tue

Maya (CS): Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
